finding.trigger: A provider HTTP error echoes the request credential in a Bearer header, quoted JSON credential field, or arbitrary error detail.
finding.previous_effect: ProviderRequestError artifact previews could write the configured key into provider_error.json or a successful preflight's retry evidence; transport exception text and invalid HTTP header serialization could also echo the value.
finding.fix: All six Bench implementations normalize JSON diagnostics with ensure_ascii=True, remove canonical-escaped and raw forms of the exact sent credential, redact original transport reasons before adding wrapper messages, and reject unsafe HTTP header characters with a fixed error; generic Bearer/quoted credential fields remain redacted.
preserved: raw response body bytes in memory
normal request payloads and retry parameters
original source revisions and source SHA256 provenance

additional_cases: escaped URLError/ConnectionError/Timeout reason before wrapper formatting
safe persistence of lone Unicode surrogate

notes: Only synthetic credentials were used; sockets were forbidden in capture tests.
The importer adapts each revision's existing failure branches, preserving L2's original lack of an Anthropic transport.
No Live or GPU verification was performed.
